SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version, j.attempt_count,
       j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_VPguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('item_id', CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR), 'max_id', CAST(MAX(m.id) AS CHAR),
         'latest', SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(m.transaction_type, ' ', COALESCE(m.trx_no, '')) ORDER BY m.id DESC SEPARATOR '|'), '|', 1)) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN inventory_movement m ON m.organization_id = g.organization_id AND m.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlMinLiveId}}
   AND m.plant_id = {{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlPlantId}}
   AND m.item_id IN ({{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlItemIds}})
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('GRN', 'GRN-R') AND m.trx_no = g.gr_no)
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type IN ('HU', 'HU-R') AND COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = g.gr_no)
   AND NOT (m.transaction_type = 'TO - PA' AND COALESCE(m.parent_trx_no, '') = g.gr_no)
 GROUP BY m.item_id, m.batch_number_id
 ORDER BY m.item_id, m.batch_number_id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(f.`id` AS CHAR), 'material_id', CAST(f.`material_id` AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(f.`batch_id` AS CHAR), 'fifo_cost_price', CAST(f.`fifo_cost_price` AS CHAR),
		'fifo_initial_quantity', CAST(f.`fifo_initial_quantity` AS CHAR), 'fifo_available_quantity', CAST(f.`fifo_available_quantity` AS CHAR), 'fifo_sequence', f.`fifo_sequence`) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN fifo_costing_history f ON f.organization_id = g.organization_id AND f.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND f.id > g.id AND f.plant_id = {{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlPlantId}} AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlItemIds}})
 ORDER BY f.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(w.`id` AS CHAR), 'material_id', CAST(w.`material_id` AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(w.`batch_id` AS CHAR), 'wa_quantity', CAST(w.`wa_quantity` AS CHAR),
		'wa_cost_price', CAST(w.`wa_cost_price` AS CHAR)) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN wa_costing_method w ON w.organization_id = g.organization_id AND w.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlPlantId}}' AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlItemIds}})
   AND (w.batch_id IS NULL OR w.id > g.id)
 ORDER BY w.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('t', x.t, 'material_id', x.material_id, 'cnt', x.cnt) AS j FROM (
SELECT 'FIFO' AS t, CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN fifo_costing_history f ON f.organization_id = g.organization_id AND f.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND f.plant_id = {{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlPlantId}} AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlItemIds}})
 GROUP BY f.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WA' AS t, CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN wa_costing_method w ON w.organization_id = g.organization_id AND w.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
   AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlPlantId}}' AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_VPprep.data.sqlItemIds}})
 GROUP BY w.material_id
) x ORDER BY x.t, x.material_id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(p.`id` AS CHAR), 'purchase_invoice_no', p.`purchase_invoice_no`, 'pi_status', p.`pi_status`) AS j
  FROM goods_receiving g
  JOIN purchase_invoice p
    ON p.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND p.organization_id = g.organization_id AND p.is_deleted = 0
   AND (JSON_CONTAINS(p.gr_id, JSON_QUOTE('{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}}')) OR JSON_CONTAINS(p.gr_id, '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}}'))
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY p.id

 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_VPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND g.id = {{node:code_node_VPentry.data.grId}} AND g.is_deleted = 0
